description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Method_Append class, which implements the append() method for appending values to template variables within the Smarty template engine. It belongs to the internal plugin methods of Smarty.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_Append
classes.description: Class providing the append() method to add values to Smarty template variables within the Smarty internal plugin system.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends values to specified template variables in Smarty's internal data structure.
